operators.name: custom_linear_forward

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: same as reference step linear input [512, 32, 160, 32]

returns.shape: same as reference step linear output [512, 32, 160, 64]

semantics: Performs linear transformation on the last dimension of the input, equivalent to torch.nn.functional.linear(input, weight, bias).
Keeps the same broadcasting semantics and adds bias if provided.

operators.name: custom_silu_forward

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: same as reference step silu input [512, 32, 160, 64]

semantics: Applies the SiLU (swish) activation function element-wise, equivalent to F.silu(input).

operators.name: custom_permute_forward

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: same as reference step permute input [512, 32, 160, 64]

returns.shape: same as reference step permute output [512, 160, 64, 32]

semantics: Returns a tensor with dimensions permuted according to the provided dims tuple, equivalent to torch.permute(input, dims).
Supports any contiguous or non-contiguous input by explicitly handling strides.
Computes linear transformation: output[b, c, h, w_out] = sum_{k} input[b, c, h, k] * weight[w_out, k] + bias[w_out]
Broadcasting and dtype follow PyTorch linear semantics.
Applies SiLU activation element-wise: output = input * sigmoid(input)
Permutes dimensions from (batch, channels, height, width) to (batch, height, width, channels).
Returns the permuted tensor as the final model output.
